messages.subject: INLA book on-line
parts:
Hi,

The first full draft of a book on INLA I have been working is available here:

https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/index.html

The book will be published by CRC in a few months and feedback is welcome. Of course, this has been possible by all the excellent work done by Håvard Rue and all members of the INLA team, with whom I have had many talks about INLA.

Best,

Virgilio
